name: AMO-Bench
intro: AMO-Bench 由数学专家原创并给出逐步解答，经至少3名专家盲审、10-gram与网页原创性检查以及多模型难度筛选，最终保留50道达到或超过IMO难度的问题；39题由解析器评分，11题由o4-mini五次裁判多数投票评分。
org: Meituan, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Harbin Institute of Technology
build_method: 数学专家原创出题, 三人以上盲审, 原创性与难度复核
eval_feature: IMO级难度, 原创防泄漏, 解析器与LLM混合评分
build_method_en: Expert-authored original problems, three-or-more-expert blind review, originality and difficulty review
eval_feature_en: IMO-level difficulty, original leakage-resistant tasks, parser and LLM hybrid grading
intro_en: AMO-Bench starts with original problems and step-by-step solutions written by mathematics experts, applies blind review by at least three experts, 10-gram and web originality checks, and multi-model difficulty filtering, then retains 50 IMO-level-or-harder problems. Thirty-nine items use parser grading and eleven use five-vote o4-mini judging.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2510.26768 and the AMO-Bench project page. The paper uses four construction stages: expert problem creation with worked solutions, blind review by at least three experts, originality review through 10-gram matching plus web search, and difficulty review requiring IMO-level expert validation and failures by at least two advanced models. The final 50 problems use parser grading for 39 numerical/set/expression answers and five-sample o4-mini majority judging for 11 descriptive answers.
